explanations.1: This sets an environment variable that tells the ripgrep tool (rg) where to find its configuration file in your home directory.
explanations.4: The ~ symbol expands to your home directory, and *.zsh means "all files ending with .zsh", so this loop runs through each custom function file.
explanations.5: The source command reads and executes the contents of each function file, making those functions available in your shell.
explanations.15: The --glob flags filter search results to only match files with names like "Dockerfile" or ending in ".dockerfile".
